source: Census Bureau Oct. 2026 new home sales via Inman, Real Estate News and Calculated Risk

headline: New home sales
*jump 14.2%*
slides.fig_caption: October's annualized sales pace, the *fastest this year*
slides.sub: Up 7.5% from a year ago and well above forecasts. But there's a catch.

slides.title: Sales pace, *annualized*
slides.note: September was revised down from 676K, which inflates the monthly jump. Year to date, sales are still *3% behind 2025*, and down 1.8% in the Midwest.

slides.label: new homes sold in October went for *under $300,000*
slides.body: A share not seen since 2021. The median new home price fell 3.2% from a year ago to $391,300, about $25,000 below the median existing home.

slides.title: Builders are *making deals*
slides.body: Nearly half of builders are cutting prices and about two-thirds are offering incentives. With supply at 8 months, the lowest this year, new construction belongs in every buyer search.
